description: This file is a shell script used for initializing and populating the volatile filesystem during system startup, including creating files, directories, and symbolic links based on configuration files.

methods.name: create_file
methods.description: Creates a file by touching or copying from a source, sets ownership and permissions.

methods.name: mk_dir
methods.description: Creates a directory with specified permissions and ownership.

methods.name: link_file
methods.description: Creates or updates a symbolic link, handling existing links or directories.

methods.name: check_requirements
methods.description: Validates user and group existence and required directories based on configuration.

methods.name: apply_cfgfile
methods.description: Applies configuration files to create files, directories, and links as specified.
